description: session.rs line 288: the EHLO handler advertises AUTH PLAIN whenever (is_tls || is_submission || tls_acceptor.is_some()) and credentials are configured. When tls_acceptor.is_some() and !is_tls, this means AUTH is advertised on a cleartext connection alongside STARTTLS. RFC 4954 §4 requires that AUTH only be advertised after TLS is active. A broken or attacker-controlled client could send AUTH PLAIN credentials in the clear before upgrading. The 530 guard on the AUTH handler is correct, but the advertisement is the bug. Fix: change auth_line condition to omit AUTH when !is_tls && tls_acceptor.is_some().
title: smtp: AUTH advertised in EHLO before STARTTLS negotiated — RFC 4954 §4
